title: Grouped invariant-pair export tables v1
description: Normalized table contract. Each table is exported independently to avoid empty nested structs in Parquet.

x-table-contracts.invariant_pairs: One row per accepted pair and export subset. Includes decoded anchor_image and paired_image columns plus IDs, class, domains, semantic fields, judgment stage, validation scope, group/run provenance, spec hashes, and checksums.
x-table-contracts.proposal_ledger: One row per proposal or abstention, including model, prompt, candidate pool, scores, explanation, uncertainty, and raw-output reference.
x-table-contracts.groups: One row per group with semantic key, requested and actual size, coverage summary, highlighted roles, and summary versions.
x-table-contracts.group_members: One row per pair/group membership with stable position and highlighted roles.
x-table-contracts.judgments: One row per append-only initial, revised, correction, or confirmation event. Raw response and parsed response are JSON strings, never empty structs.
x-table-contracts.image_descriptions: One row per image-description version with structured fields flattened or encoded as JSON strings and a raw-output reference.
